entities.summary: The murder of Mattia Ahmet Minguzzi refers to the fatal assault on a 14-year-old boy in Kadıköy, a district on the Anatolian side of Istanbul, Turkey. The incident, which occurred on 24 January 2025, has received international press coverage and has sparked an intense public discussion over youth violence in the country.
